spans.s:
मौख मौख, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. मुख), relat-
ing or belonging to the mouth or face, frontal; (अम्),
n. a fault or defect connected with the mouth.
मौखिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = मौख above.

मौखर मौखर (fr. मुखर), epithet of
a family or race (‘talkative?’).

मौखर्य, अम्, n. talkativeness, garrulity, lo-
quaciousness; scurrility, defamation, abusiveness,
abuse, calumny, vilification; (आ), the feminine form
of Maukhari above, (according to Scholiast on Pāṇ.
